jyutping: jin2 dak1 ci5 mou4 ci5 joeng6

english.note: Use this specifically when an actor portrays a role so convincingly that they look and behave like the character.

examples.english: They act so convincingly that they convince everyone they really are a doctor.
examples.traditional: 佢演得似模似樣，成班人都相信佢真係個醫生。
